content: Ananya Nair follows up with insurance agent Vikram Patel regarding the reinstatement of her auto policy with DCoders. Vikram confirms that the processing is underway and that she will receive a confirmation email shortly. He also confirms that the $50 penalty will be charged to the credit card currently on file.

action_items: Send policy reinstatement confirmation email to customer
Process $50 penalty using the credit card on file
